title: Review Report
description: Aggregated multi-perspective QA report for a draft document. Contains issue lists from all applied QA perspectives and the final gate decision.

draft_ref.description: Path or ID of the draft document being reviewed

brief_id.description: ID of the brief against which this draft is being reviewed

run_id.description: Cache run ID this review belongs to

perspectives_applied.description: List of QA perspectives that were applied — all six standard perspectives plus final are expected for most documents

issues.description: Aggregated issue list from all perspectives — sorted by severity (block first, then revise, then note)

issue_id.description: Unique identifier for this issue within the review

perspective.description: QA perspective that identified this issue

severity.description: block = must be resolved before document advances; revise = should be fixed; note = optional improvement

location.description: Section title, paragraph reference, or quoted text identifying where the issue occurs

description.description: Specific description of the issue — must be actionable, not vague

suggested_fix.description: Concrete suggestion for how to resolve this issue

gate_decision.description: ACCEPT = document advances; REVISE = revisions required, rewrite plan produced; BLOCK = cannot advance until blocking issues resolved

gate_justification.description: Explanation of the gate decision — required for REVISE and BLOCK; recommended for ACCEPT

blocking_issues_count.description: Count of issues with severity = block

revise_issues_count.description: Count of issues with severity = revise

created_by.description: Agent ID that produced this review report (typically lead-editor)
